robolectric-testing/com.google.maps.android.robolectric.truth/Distance

Distance

data class Distance(val meters: Double) : Comparable<Distance>

Represents a physical geodesic distance on the Earth's surface.

Implements Comparable and provides a concise human-readable toString (e.g., "14.2m" or "1.50km") so that both Google Truth subjects and Kotlin Power-Assert expression diagrams render clear physical distances without manual formatting.
